thread:
aisha: Quick check-in for Foxglove Week0 private/VPC onboarding. Two items blocking: TGW route propagation failing, and KMS alias rotation policy causing decrypt errors to their SIEM forwarder.

tom-csm: hi all 90% of Foxglove team online for a short sync at 10. Need status to share.

lucy-eng: TGW peering looks UP but routes not propagating to the child route table. console shows association missing for rt-0f1a2b3c.

nikhil-sre: can you confirm whether the attachment is associated to the correct propagation table or if it's attached to the wrong VPC? I can run a script to list propagations.

aisha: attachment id tgw-attach-0abcde12345. Foxglove used a terraform module that created a separate route table per AZ; might be missing the propagate flag.

nikhil-sre: running quick check now.

ops-bot: scheduled job: tgw-prop-check for foxglove at 2024-06-22T17:40:00Z.

nikhil-sre: found the issue: terraform module had propagate = false on two child RTs. Patching propagate=true on rt-0f1a2b3c and rt-0f4a5b6c. Applying change momentarily.

lucy-eng: after propagation fix, please validate connectivity from their app subnet to redwood infra endpoint (10.100.5.12).

olivia-ops: noted. Also, Foxglove reported CloudWatch Log Groups show "AccessDenied" when our forwarder tries to read encrypted payloads. Sample error: "AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/rot-2024".

lucy-eng: do we have the KMS alias? they rotated keys last week, maybe alias points to a new key without grant to rwd-forwarder-role.

nikhil-sre: request: provide recommended IAM trust snippet to Foxglove to add to their key policy OR add a grant. Prefer explicit grant over key policy change. Snippet for grant API using aws kms create-grant: "GranteePrincipal": "arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/rwd-forwarder-role", "Operations": ["Decrypt"]

olivia-ops: Foxglove's sec team is strict about principals. They asked for a time-bounded grant and audit trail. We'll propose a 24h grant for smoke, then indicate how to automate a long-lived solution.

tom-csm: please draft that ask and I'll send it to their SecOps. Also need ETA for when logging will be green for their SOC ingest.

aisha: drafting message: 1) we will create a 24h grant for rwd-forwarder-role to unblock smoke, 2) recommended long-term: add explicit principal to CMK key policy or a periodic role-based grant in their infra, 3) provide CloudTrail proof of grant for audit.

lucy-eng: added runbook section: "kms-grant-temp" with commands and rollback. Will push to onboarding repo.

nikhil-sre: TGW propagation fix applied. validating connectivity: traceroute from fox-app1 -> 10.100.5.12 succeeds to infra hop now.

ops-bot: scheduled run: invoke-forwarder-smoke for foxglove at 2024-06-22T17:55:00Z.

olivia-ops: after we create temp grant, forwarder test should show Decrypt OK. Foxglove please share SOC test index name for verification.

foxglove-bot (external): "SOC index: fox-soc-smoke. We'll review and confirm once we see events."

nikhil-sre: created 24h grant via KMS create-grant (grantId: g-7890abcd). Triggering forwarder test now.

lucy-eng: small note: their IAM role lacked sts:AssumeRole trust for our rwd-deploy role used during smoke; added an audit check to run at onboarding start.

ops-bot: forwarder test result: 2024-06-22T17:56:10Z 92 Decrypt: SUCCESS, forwarded event to fox-soc-smoke.

olivia-ops: verified in SIEM: test event landed with expected fields. Marking audit-forwarding = green (smoke).

tom-csm: great, I'll tell Foxglove. Two asks: (1) can we get their SOC to sign-off on long-lived key policy changes? (2) renewal check: their committed usage is low; we've flagged renewal risk if onboarding not complete within 10 business days.

aisha: adding renewal risk note in CRM: severity=medium, reason="low utilization + delayed onboarding tasks". Recommend weekly exec updates until usage >50% of commitment.

lucy-eng: PR opened for two checklist items: auto-validate TGW propagation and preflight KMS alias policy check. Link: https://git.internal/rwd/onboarding/pulls/402.

nikhil-sre: lessons for runbook: require a preflight that verifies (a) TGW propagate=true, (b) route table associations, (c) KMS alias and grants, (d) assume-role trust. This would have caught it earlier.

tom-csm: schedule exec sync Wed 9am PT if no further issues. Foxglove wants a short readout.

foxglove-bot (external): "Thanks all 92 Approved temp grant and will review long-term key policy with SecOps by EOD PT."

aisha: summary: TGW propagation fix  done, temporary KMS grant created  done (smoke green), forwarder verified  done, pending: SOC sign-off on permanent key policy, update runbook PR, renewal monitor in CRM. I'll update onboarding tracker and close week0 blockers once permanent policy applied.

renewals: noted medium risk; I'll follow up in 48h and escalate if no policy progress. :clipboard:

lucy-eng: thanks everyone 97 will follow up on PR feedback and add more details to the KMS docs.

aisha: end thread: quick wins today, keeping exec sync on standby. Thanks team. :sparkles:"
